verdict.rationale: Calendly's docs explicitly name a versioned 'Calendly API v2' and include a v1-to-v2 migration guide, so explicit API versioning is first-party documented. Nothing in the evidence describes a deprecation policy: no timelines, sunset notices, or compatibility guarantees. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation/sunset policy, versioning or changelog rules beyond the v2 label, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: The Calendly API v2 is REST-based and has predictable resource-oriented URLs.
Use a personal access token to authenticate an internal or private application with the Calendly API v2.
